question: The diarrhea associated with the consumption of antibiotics is usually caused by:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Antibiotics -> alter gut microbiota composition -> overgrowth of Clostridium difficile -> diarrhea -> Clostridium difficile is usually the cause -> 85%
